summary: For every 1<=q<2, arbitrary cap-one product inputs do not admit a universal unweighted L^q phase-space bound for one independent-copy ambiguity cell. An explicit N-fragment density gives a lower bound (1/2)(3/(2pi))^q N^(2-q)(1-1/N). This refutes only the proposed sub-L2 ambiguity-cell closure, not the QFORM bounded-density conjecture. The q=2 raw phase-space budget remains uniformly bounded by pi.
scope: Proof-interface correction only; preserve signed/raw coupled identity rather than seeking q<2 individual-cell norms.
